@bobylito oh sorry I was confused, only that one module, MenuSelect. I looked quickly at the error and saw two different files, `MenuSelect.js` and `menu-select.js` and thought it was two different modules.

We do use instantsearch with Angular, but an older version. Haven't started using the new Angular native instantsearch. We will look into using it once [this issue is closed](https://github.com/algolia/angular-instantsearch/issues/44), it's a big one for us.
